intended_behavior: Extend the baseline workflow to establish a workdir for local code scanning. Implement embedding generation of scanned code using an embedding model (starting with OpenAI) and persist these embeddings using the Memory class. This integration should preserve all existing interactions, cached steps, and agent workflows.

Finalize and enhance the Memory class to provide robust embedding management, including adding, querying, peeking, retrieving, deleting, counting, and resetting embedding records. This class should support LanceDB PoC integration for efficient embedding storage and retrieval to enable RAG in the local code generation workflow.
